name: Prophetic
author: ratbuddy
summary: The Korg Prophecy's synthesis, built on your computer from your own Prophecy v2.0 ROMs: their DSP programs and sound-engine firmware, translated to C++. 128 programs, every parameter, Performance Editor, arpeggiator, 1-8 voices. Gen2; tested on an MPC Live III.

requires_user_files.name: Prophecy v2.0 ic12 dump (512 KiB)
requires_user_files.description: Your own dump of the V55PI ROM, SHA-1 950baf1f6c54394e780898634b7776e49f43acce.

requires_user_files.name: Prophecy v2.0 ic22 dump (512 KiB)
requires_user_files.description: Your own dump of the H8/3003 ROM, SHA-1 cd4cb221da19dd6f746dc7f3c145b1494993f6d8.

build.command: python3 tools/make_plugin.py <folder or .zip with your dumps>
